blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines— Arellano snapped its three-game losing streak after edging San Beda, 56-55, in the NCAA Season 102 men’s basketball tournament at San Juan Arena on Tuesday night. Basty Valencia came through down the stretch with the game-winner to help the Chiefs improve to 5-3 in Group A. “We really needed this win,” said an exhausted Valencia. “We’re coming from three straight losses. We need this momentum before we face off our bracket mates again. Like I always say before the start of our games, we’ll do what’s needed to win.” A free-throw split by Arellano’s Aaron Manansala cut the Chiefs’ […]...
